title: Quick guide
attendance_body: Every cell has three states: present ✓, absent ✗ and not taken –. Tap a cell to cycle through them. Not taken is a valid state: the class has not been recorded yet.
summary_body: 3 / 4 means 3 present out of 4 attendances recorded, on that row or column.
ai_body: For each delivery you pick a level: No AI, AI suspicion (IA!) or AI certainty (IA!!). The cell draws IA! or IA!! in the corner when a level is set.
roster_body: Paste one name per line; each name is looked up and reused if it already exists. The legajo is optional: without it, the exact name identifies the student within the cursada.
